payout_quote: 360 Performance Savings Bonus. Here is how to earn your cash bonus: 1. Open: Open a new 360 Performance Savings account with promo code BONUS1500. 2. Deposit: Deposit $20,000+ of external funds during the 15-day Initial Funding Period after opening your account. 3. Hold: Hold the deposit(s) in your account for 90 days after the 15-day Initial Funding Period ends. 4. Earn: See the bonus in your new account within 60 days after holding. Official bonus chart: $20,000+ -> $300; $50,000+ -> $750; $100,000+ -> $1,500. Bonus amount will be determined as follows: $300 bonus / $750 bonus / $1,500 bonus - based on the new money deposited from an external bank during the Initial Funding Period.
steps: Open a new Capital One 360 Performance Savings account online using promo code BONUS1500.
Deposit external funds (new money from another bank) within the 15-day Initial Funding Period: $20,000+ for $300, $50,000+ for $750, $100,000+ for $1,500.
Hold the deposit amount in the account for 90 days after the Initial Funding Period ends.
Bonus is deposited into the account within 60 days after the holding period.
catches: Requires parking large sums: $20,000 minimum for the $300 tier, $100,000 for the full $1,500.
Funds must be external (new money from another institution), not transfers between Capital One accounts.
Full balance must be maintained for 90 days after the 15-day funding window - money is tied up ~105 days.
Ineligible if you have or had a 360 Performance Savings, 360 Savings, 360 Money Market, Savings Now, or Confidence Savings account on or after January 1, 2024.
Account must be in good standing (not in default, closed, or suspended) at payout.
No stated offer end date - can be changed or withdrawn.
Official terms: Bonuses are considered interest and will be reported on IRS form 1099-INT.
biggest_catch: This is a high-balance savings bonus: you must park $20,000-$100,000 of outside money for ~105 days to earn $300-$1,500 - the return is modest relative to the capital tied up.
eligibility: New 360 savings customers nationwide; must not have held a Capital One 360 savings/money-market product on or after 1/1/2024.
timing: Bonus deposited within 60 days after completing the 90-day holding period (roughly 5-6 months after account opening).
